params.body:
Until now a trend reached gentells.com only when a person approved it: from the morning curation mail (Approve / Skip, six proposals a day), the Studio, or the Overview's "Put on gentells.com". A trend nobody answered never went up, and nobody could say how much time the sign-off asked. This makes the existing bars the approval, and leaves a person the veto.

## What changes

**`publishByRules`** (`packages/core/articles-store.mjs`) puts a trend on gentells.com when it passes the bars that already held it back:
- strength 80 or more, at most 45 days old, not decided, not already cited by a post (the morning's candidates, `listShowcaseCandidates`), plus the proposals nobody answered, under the same two bars;
- seen at least `TW_SITE_MIN_OBSERVED` (5) times on platforms, the gate `decideShowcase` already enforces;
- not lapsed (a lapsed trend is no card on the site);
- at most `TW_SITE_AUTO_PER_WEEK` (default **10**) in seven days, spread as a seventh a day (two a day at 10), freshest first, then strongest.

Each goes up as a decision by `site rules`, via `auto`, in `showcase_decisions`, so a trend's history names who put it there. A trend taken off (hidden) or skipped is never put up again by the rules. Approvals by a person do not count against the weekly number.

**The morning run** (`packages/server/curation.mjs`): with the rules on, the daily run publishes, tells the site (`notifyProjection('trends')`), and mails the team "On gentells.com since today": one card per trend with a signed "Take it off gentells.com" link (action `hidden`, the existing `/curate/decide` route), and how many more pass the rules and wait for room. With `TW_SITE_AUTO_PER_WEEK=0` the lane is what it was: six proposals with Approve / Skip.

## On the box

Nothing to run: the default is on, at 10 a week. To change the pace, set `TW_SITE_AUTO_PER_WEEK` in the box's environment and restart the server; `0` turns the rules off.

From the first morning after deploy, the waiting list (unanswered proposals that are still fresh and strong enough) goes up two a day, freshest first.

## Tests

`npm test`: 1612 of 1612. `tsc`: clean. New: `test/site-rules.test.mjs` (what passes, what is held back, unanswered proposals, the daily and weekly limit, taken off stays off, rules off; the morning run publishes, notifies and mails take-off links, and proposes as before at 0).
params.title: Trends go on gentells.com by the site rules
